name: Wipro Ltd
title: Wipro Ltd - 507685 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wipro Q4 FY26 revenue flat sequentially (+0.2% cc) with Americas 2 down 2.6% QoQ and Q1 guided -2% to 0%; book-to-bill weak at ~1.3x on $3.5bn orders, with large deal ramp delays and margin pressure ahead.

triggers.label: Q1 guide -2% to 0% QoQ cc
triggers.quote: In Q1, we are guiding for a sequential growth of minus 2% to 0% in constant currency terms.

triggers.label: Americas 2 down 2.6% QoQ
triggers.quote: Americas 2 declined 2.6% sequentially and 6.7% on a YoY basis.

triggers.label: Large deals margin dilution flagged
triggers.quote: The y will come with their share of lower margins, especially as we start these deals, right?

triggers.label: Unbilled revenue up over $80m
triggers.quote: the unbilled revenue has grown this quarter for more than $80 million.

guidance.metric: IT Services revenue Q1 FY27 (cc QoQ)
guidance.quote: In Q1, we are guiding for a sequential growth of minus 2% to 0% in constant currency terms.
our endeavour would be to maintain these margins in a narrow band in the medium term.

guidance.value: INR15,000 crore at INR250/share, ~5.7% of paid-up capital
guidance.quote: the Board of Directors have announced and approved a buyback of INR15,000 crores at a price of INR250 per share.

red_flags.label: Q1 guide implies sharp organic decline ex-deals
red_flags.quote: So these aside, I think the remaining business seems to be quite a sharp decline in Q1.

red_flags.label: Top client sequential decline
red_flags.quote: it's a sequential decline. But from a YoY standpoint, it continues to have grown.

red_flags.label: Unbilled revenue build
red_flags.quote: the unbilled revenue has grown this quarter for more than $80 million.

evasions.topic: Ramp-up delay cause on large BFSI deal
evasions.quote: The reason for the delay is a very client specific, but we see opportunity coming up sooner than later
They are not inorganic. They are actually strategic deal wins.
